title: January 2016 Civic Hall announcement
publicNote: Civic Hall announced a January 30, 2016 New York City Council hackathon focused on constituent services for 1-3 p.m.; a Wayback capture preserves the post in Civic Hall's embedded feed.
materialLimitations: The announced hours do not independently establish actual event duration.
The archived feed is not a recovered event listing.

publicNote: The New York City Council described the Civic Hall gathering as its first CouncilStat hackathon; the recovered Council-branded graphic reads 'New York City Council Hackathon.'
materialLimitations: The Council wording does not establish a first civic-data hackathon of every kind.
The graphic does not establish a longer formal registration title.
